command:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,time,runpy,datetime
r=Path("WORKTREE");out=Path("WORKTREE/artifacts/registry-consumers-36b367f-20261120");out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source="36b367ffda4cea9b3b3dfbf38dc6375567912323"
git=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(["git",*a],cwd=r,text=True).strip()
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD")==source
assert not git("status","--porcelain","--untracked-files=no")
assert not (out/"result.json").exists(),"preserve prior registry results"
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
before=sha(r/"Cargo.lock")
command=["/usr/bin/python3","tools/verify_registry.py","--output",str(out/"result.json"),"--cargo-timeout","90"]
receipt={"source":source,"timestamp_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"command":command,"tool_sha256":sha(r/"tools/verify_registry.py"),"lock_before":before,"ok":False}
start=time.monotonic()
try:
 with (out/"run.log").open("wb") as log:
  c=subprocess.run(command,cwd=r,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=900)
 receipt["exit_code"]=c.returncode
 assert c.returncode==0,"registry consumer command failed"
 data=json.loads((out/"result.json").read_text())
 assert data["ok"] and len(data["individual_checks"])==6 and data["combined_check"]["ok"]
 api=next(x for x in data["packages"] if x["name"]=="ztty-plugin-api")
 assert api["version"]=="0.1.0" and api["vcs"]["git"]["sha1"]==source
 assert api["cargo_lock_checksum"]=="e00adc5df1eefa237ea1ccd8d837ceecabef1976141b78918901d95cb8e9d4a6"
 expected={"zgpui":("0.1.0","1d796d1fc63808dc099ed7b10c92e75835ae2814"),"zinput":("0.1.3","37617313dd7aaabcca9dd567344a76c4cbe03907"),"zpty":("0.2.2","66919bc6dcb7757e0437fe955bfa809fb1282b68"),"zgraphics":("0.2.0","fe6357f98cf80fb6cc74739e45e8866ee17706ad"),"zterm":("0.5.0","13d5e2c74571d35cccd920b1204798211b70c79f"),"ztty-plugin-api":("0.1.0",source)}
 for check in [*data["individual_checks"],data["combined_check"]]:
  for package in check["packages"]:
   if package["selected"]:
    assert (package["version"],package["vcs"]["git"]["sha1"])==expected[package["name"]]
    assert package["cargo_lock_checksum"] and package["library_source_has_no_std"]
 assert sha(r/"Cargo.lock")==before and git("rev-parse","HEAD")==source
 assert not git("status","--porcelain","--untracked-files=no")
 receipt.update(ok=True,individual_checks=6,combined_check=True,packages=data["packages"])
except Exception as error:receipt["error"]=repr(error)
finally:
 receipt["elapsed_seconds"]=time.monotonic()-start
 receipt["resources"]=runpy.run_path(str(r/"artifacts/plugin-api-publication-20261120/publish.py"))["own_resources"]()
 for key,name in [("report_sha256","result.json"),("log_sha256","run.log")]:
  if (out/name).exists():receipt[key]=sha(out/name)
 (out/"closure.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if receipt["ok"] else 1)
